'''''Riptide''''' is a paperback novel by [[Paul S. Kemp]]. It is the sequel to ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', also by Kemp, and was released on [[October 25]], [[2011]].<ref name="blog">{{WebCite|url=http://paulskemp.livejournal.com/261702.html|text=''Crosscurrent'' sequel|archivedate=20091020210201}}</ref><ref name="TOSForum">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17909621#17909607|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs 3.0|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2010-06-17|time=4:10 PM}}</ref>
